title: Machine Learning based Optimization of CV-QKD Under Practical Constraints
summary: Practical hardware limitations, including finite transmitter and receiver filter lengths as well as the finite resolution of digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital converters, lead to mode mismatch and degrade the performance of continuous-variable quantum key distribution systems. To address this, we develop a machine learning-based end-to-end optimization framework that jointly optimizes transmitter pulse shaping and receiver matched filtering.
